summary: Iteration 63 regression: verified Case 1 edit-open + ownership lock (user_id/original_user_id), hot polling endpoints with new max_time_ms + graceful fallbacks (calls/active, whatsapp/unread-summary, agent/me, leads/followups/reminders), lowered socketTimeoutMS did not regress anything, iter62 caller scoping still holds, group_counts + audit trail working, and frontend caller/admin UX (my-leads-indicator vs filter-caller). Backend 17/17 pytest pass; frontend smoke pass for both roles.
critical_code_review_comments: Console shows 4x 401 during initial page load before login redirect — polling components (IncomingCallBanner/WaNotifier/AgentStatusSwitcher) fire before auth cookie is ready. Not blocking but consider gating polls on auth-ready to reduce noise.

Audit endpoint responded 200 with array; recent field edits visible in Activity Log chatter. Ensure PATCH ownership-lock also emits an audit event when stripped keys are attempted (currently only successful field changes are logged).
seed_data_creation: None (all city edits reverted; admin reassign restored to original user_id=1001)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_iter63_case1_and_hotpath_timeouts.py for future regressions. It covers: auth, caller scoping (~5270), admin unscoped (~119813) + user_id filter, edit-open (caller can PATCH any lead of their own; can OPEN any lead), ownership lock (caller PATCH strips user_id + original_user_id, admin reassigns user_id but original_user_id immutable), hot polling shape verification (calls/active/whatsapp unread/agent me/followups reminders), group_counts (stage & user_id, caller+admin), audit endpoint. Frontend testids relied upon: my-leads-indicator, filter-caller.
